devdoc.details: Extracted from DepositManager to reduce contract size.         Key Features:         - Creator-only minting/burning: Only the contract that creates a token can mint/burn it         - ERC6909 compatibility with optional ERC20 wrapping via CloneableReceiptToken clones         - Deterministic token ID generation based on owner, asset, deposit period, and operator         - Automatic wrapped token creation for seamless DeFi integration         Security Model:         - Token ownership is immutable and set to msg.sender during creation         - All mint/burn operations are gated by onlyTokenOwner modifier         - Token IDs include owner address to prevent collision attacks

Approval(address,address,uint256,uint256.details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set for a token of type `id`. The new allowance is `amount`.

ERC6909DecimalsUpdated(uint256,uint8).details: The decimals value for token of type `id` was updated to `newDecimals`.

ERC6909NameUpdated(uint256,string).details: The name of the token of type `id` was updated to `newName`.

ERC6909SymbolUpdated(uint256,string).details: The symbol for the token of type `id` was updated to `newSymbol`.

OperatorSet(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` grants or revokes operator status for a `spender`.

Transfer(address,address,address,uint256.details: Emitted when `amount` tokens of type `id` are moved from `sender` to `receiver` initiated by `caller`.

allowance(address,address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` that `spender` is allowed to spend on behalf of `owner`. NOTE: Does not include operator allowances.

approve(address,uint256,uint256).details: Sets an approval to `spender` for `amount` of tokens of type `id` from the caller's tokens. An `amount` of `type(uint256).max` signifies an unlimited approval. Must return true.

balanceOf(address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` owned by `owner`.

burn(address,uint256,uint256,bool).details: This function reverts if:             - The token ID is invalid (not created)             - The caller is not the token owner             - The account is the zero address             - The amount is 0             - For wrapped tokens: account has not approved ReceiptTokenManager to spend the wrapped ERC20 token             - For unwrapped tokens: account has not approved the caller to spend ERC6909 tokens             - The account has insufficient token balance

createToken(address,uint8,address,string.details: This function reverts if:             - The asset is the zero address             - The deposit period is 0             - The operator is the zero address             - A token with the same parameters already exists

params.operatorName_: The operator name for token metadata

decimals(uint256).details: Returns the number of decimals for the token of type `id`.

params.tokenId_: The ID of the receipt token

returns._0: The decimals of the receipt token

params.tokenId_: The ID of the receipt token

returns._0: The name of the receipt token

params.tokenId_: The ID of the receipt token

returns._0: The symbol of the receipt token

returns.wrappedTokens: The wrapped token addresses of all tokens

params.tokenId_: The ID of the ERC6909 token

returns.wrappedToken: The address of the wrapped ERC20 token (or zero address)

isOperator(address,address).details: Returns true if `spender` is set as an operator for `owner`.

params.tokenId_: The ID of the ERC6909 token

returns._0: Whether the token ID is valid

mint(address,uint256,uint256,bool).details: This function reverts if:             - The token ID is invalid (not created)             - The caller is not the token owner             - The recipient is the zero address             - The amount is 0

name(uint256).details: Returns the name of the token of type `id`.

setOperator(address,bool).details: Grants or revokes unlimited transfer permission of any token id to `spender` for the caller's tokens. Must return true.

symbol(uint256).details: Returns the ticker symbol of the token of type `id`.

totalSupply(uint256).details: Returns the total supply of the token of type `id`.

transfer(address,uint256,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from the caller's account to `receiver`. Must return true.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256,uin.details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from `sender` to `receiver`. Must return true.

unwrap(uint256,uint256).details: This function will burn the wrapped ERC20 token from the caller and mint the ERC6909 token to the same address.             This function reverts if:             - The token ID does not exist             - The amount is zero             - The caller has an insufficient balance of the wrapped token

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to unwrap
params.tokenId_: The ID of the ERC6909 token

wrap(uint256,uint256).details: This function will burn the ERC6909 token from the caller and mint the wrapped ERC20 token to the same address.             This function reverts if:             - The token ID does not exist             - The amount is zero             - The caller has an insufficient balance of the token

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to wrap
params.tokenId_: The ID of the ERC6909 token

returns.wrappedToken: The address of the wrapped ERC20 token
